description: Forecast whether your Claude Code and Codex limits last until reset, and see each thread's context fill above the composer. A band shows every limit window with a pace tick, the context breakdown and a Compact button, and adds a learned forecast once windows have closed. Optional auto-compact, off by default, compacts an idle thread above a threshold you set; each compact runs a turn on the thread's provider and counts against its limits. Limits appear only for providers that report them to bb, today Claude Code and Codex. The server polls bb every 2 minutes and calls no provider API.
